title: Audio-Language Datasets of Scenes and Events: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying dataset captions into AudioSet ontology categories using an LLM (Llama 3) to calculate category distributions and normalized entropy, revealing a heavy overrepresentation of indoor environments and human-generated sounds.
Surveying the source languages of the 69 audio-language datasets to document the overwhelming predominance of English captions and the scarcity of multilingual or culturally diverse data.

Analyzing the origins of visually-grounded audio datasets (e.g., those sourced from YouTube videos) to identify instances where captions inappropriately include visual details not discernible from the audio alone.
Examining bioacoustic datasets (such as AnimalSpeak) to identify skewed species distributions that overrepresent specific geographic regions like North America and Europe.
